nodes.label: AppRegistry
nodes.desc: Entry point where the JS side registers the root component and hands the first render to the renderer.

nodes.label: ReactFabric
nodes.desc: The Fabric reconciler implementation compiled for RN; talks to native through the UIManager host object.

nodes.label: TurboModuleRegistry
nodes.desc: JS front door for TurboModules: get() and getEnforcing() resolve native modules lazily by name.

nodes.label: jsi::Runtime
nodes.desc: Engine-agnostic C++ interface (Hermes, JSC, V8) that lets C++ hold and call JS values directly.

nodes.label: jsi::HostObject
nodes.desc: C++ object exposed to JS; property access lands in get() and can run native code on demand.

nodes.label: NativeToJsBridge
nodes.desc: The old async bridge used by the compatibility path: queues batched calls between native and JS.

nodes.label: Scheduler
nodes.desc: Top-level coordinator of the C++ renderer; owns shadow trees and forwards mounting output.

nodes.label: ShadowNode
nodes.desc: Immutable element in the C++ shadow tree; cloned (never mutated) on every commit.

nodes.label: ShadowTree
nodes.desc: Transactional container for revisions; tryCommit/commit swap in new trees optimistically.

nodes.label: MountingCoordinator
nodes.desc: Turns committed revisions into MountingInstruction lists the platform applies on the UI thread.

nodes.label: TurboModule
nodes.desc: Native module as a jsi::HostObject: methods resolved lazily through MethodMetadata.

nodes.label: calculateLayout()
nodes.desc: Yoga's flexbox engine entry point; computes width/height/position for every shadow node.
